# Nine-view gameplay observations

These compare the original native12-pilot bot match with the first distance-LOD optimization. They predate final canonical close-pilot batching. Bot positions differ; view labels do not establish exact matching nearby populations. Use CLIENT_PERFORMANCE.md for the final same-room six-nearby A/B. All captures1280×720, RTX3060/ANGLE,60Hz display-capped. CPU timing is not GPU time.

Numbers are before→first-optimization. Frame columns show median/p95 milliseconds. CPU columns show median/p95 milliseconds. The wall-run-view is a static review camera; real wall-running has separate controlled evidence. CSV retains every original observation and timing category.
